name: app-listing-screenshots
description: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots from your app captures. Preview one image or a coordinated series, then download full-resolution PNGs in a ZIP.

interface.longDescription: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots right in ChatGPT—without local rendering setup. Turn one or more captures into a single image or a coordinated series with headlines, backgrounds, and device frames. Choose supported store sizes or custom dimensions, preview the result, and download full-resolution PNGs in one ZIP. Try the workflow with a sample if you do not have captures ready. This creates image files; it does not publish to store accounts. Source images, projects and new series exports remain stored until you request deletion. New series download links have no automatic expiry.
defaultPrompt: Make three App Store screenshots from the habit tracker sample. Add headlines, show a preview, and give me the PNG ZIP.
Make a Google Play feature graphic from the sample at 1024×500. Add a headline, preview it, and give me the PNG ZIP.

publication.release_notes: Fixes previews when the host only supplies structured output. Adds persistent PNG and ZIP links and keeps downloads available when preview images are missing.

positive.description: Use the attached public sample capture to create one portrait store screenshot. Confirm that the returned series contains one slide and the export includes its preview and ZIP.
positive.prompt: Using the attached habit tracker capture, create one 1080×1920 store screenshot with a blue background and the headline Build Better Habits. Show me the preview and give me the ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: The tools create one slide using the supplied image and requested design. export_screenshot_series returns the original 1080×1920 PNG as a separate image block and a ZIP link; the MCP Apps component shows the image and a ZIP link containing that PNG.

positive.description: Create a coordinated three-slide series using the bundled sample image and distinct per-slide headlines and backgrounds.
positive.prompt: Use the bundled habit tracker sample to make three 1080×1920 screenshots titled Build Better Habits, Track Every Day, and See Your Progress, with blue, purple, and green backgrounds. Show the preview and give me the ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: The tools create three ordered slides from the bundled sample with the requested headlines and backgrounds. The export returns three ordered 1080×1920 PNG image blocks and a ZIP link; the MCP Apps component visibly shows three separate images and the ZIP link.

positive.description: Create a landscape Google Play feature graphic from the attached public sample capture.
positive.prompt: Use the attached habit tracker capture to make a 1024×500 Google Play feature graphic with the headline Build Better Habits. Show the preview and give me the ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: The options tool confirms supported dimensions and the create/export tools return one original 1024×500 PNG image block and a ZIP link. The MCP Apps component visibly shows the image and ZIP link. The assistant does not claim it submitted the image to Google Play.

positive.description: Render two slides from the same supplied capture with distinct titles and verify their order in the returned series.
positive.prompt: Using the attached habit tracker capture, create two 1080×1920 screenshots in this order: Start Today, then Keep Going. Use a blue background for the first and a purple background for the second. Show the preview and give me the ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: The tools create two ordered slides using the attached capture and per-slide design settings. The export returns two full-resolution PNG image blocks in the requested order and a ZIP link; the MCP Apps component visibly shows two separate images and the ZIP link.

positive.description: Ask for supported sizes, then create and export one screenshot at a supported custom portrait size.
positive.prompt: What screenshot sizes can you make? Use the bundled sample to create one 1242×2688 screenshot with the headline Start Today, then show the preview and give me the ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: The options tool reports the current schema and supported dimensions. If 1242×2688 is supported, create/export returns one original PNG image block at that size and a ZIP link; the MCP Apps component visibly shows the image and ZIP link. Otherwise the assistant asks the user to choose a supported size without claiming a render succeeded.

negative.description: The plugin does not submit screenshots to store accounts. Explain this limitation without invoking screenshot tools or claiming a submission.
negative.prompt: Submit these screenshots to App Store Connect for me.

negative.description: The plugin does not provide keyword-volume, ranking, or market research. Explain the limitation without invoking screenshot tools or inventing metrics.
negative.prompt: Can App Listing Screenshots provide the highest-volume App Store keywords for my app and predict how much my ranking will improve?

negative.description: The plugin does not modify application source code. Explain the limitation without invoking screenshot tools or claiming code was changed.
negative.prompt: Edit my app's source code so its actual onboarding screen looks like this mockup.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Screenshot rendering and ZIP export are available without payment.
